messages:
Zoe: Quick heads-up  all-hands starts in 10m (11:00 PT). Tiny agenda change: live Q&A moved to 11:30 so leadership can join a customer sync at 12. Presenters join 'Presenters' Zoom 5m early.
Marcus: Noted. Can we confirm recording retention? I need to know whether to scrub a confidential slide after the meeting.
Priya: Default retention is 90d. For conf slides we can tag the S3 object 'internal' and request manual purge after 7d. Ping @sec if you need an exception.
Dan: Last meeting had a caption dropout after an OBS scene switch. Any changes to RTMP bridges?
Chloe: I replaced one bridge yesterday to reduce latency; I set caption_passthrough=true. I'll run the pre-check now.
stream-bot: stream-health (us-east-2) OK. encoders: v2.1.7, caption_passthrough=true, ingest_latency_ms=102. Next maintenance window 2026-04-01T03:00Z.
Chloe: Ran the encoder check: v2.1.7, status=OK. OBS key verified. I'll enable dual-recording (local OBS + cloud) as backup.
Zoe: Hosts: ask people to raise hands and paste a one-line question in chat. Marcus will triage top 6. We'll open follow-up threads for remaining items.
Marcus: I'll curate. If captions fail we switch to audio-only + post recording link and notes.
Priya: Reminder: don't show embargoed roadmap slides; mark them 'internal-only' in the deck. We'll blackout screenshots if needed.
Dan: Quick checklist before go: 1) Zoom >=5.14, 2) OBS scenes loaded, 3) slide auto-advance OFF. Paste your zoom --version if presenting.
Zoe: Thanks  starting presenter dry-run in 5m. See you all shortly.
